xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5418: Diff window All turns: each file's diff still includes other agents' edits since the session start

plan.title: Diff window All turns: each file's diff still includes other agents' edits since the session start
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: All turns in the conversation diff window lists the right files since PAN-5408, but each file's patch and +/- counts span from a session-start base commit to the working tree, so every foreign commit to the same file (other agents) is shown as this conversation's work (LeftColumn.tsx +214 instead of +2 -2).
narratives.Proposal: New module conversation-diff-own.ts builds each attributed file's patch from the conversation's own attributed commits and uncommitted edit: one combined git diff <first>^..<last|worktree> when content checks prove nothing foreign changed the file in between, otherwise one git show section per attributed commit plus an Uncommitted section, each with an mbox From/Subject preamble the diff window renders as a header label. Counts are the Changes API per-file sums. getConversationDiffFull's cwd block delegates to it. Docs and changelog describe the new scoping. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5418.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing /diffs/:turnId, getConversationDiffs summaries, vs main, Compare or non-cwd repositories
- Line-level filtering of other agents' uncommitted lines inside a file the conversation also edited
- Changing the Changes API, its counts or attribution rules
- Adding new fields to the /diffs/full response (labels travel in the patch text)
- Commit labels on any route other than conversation All turns

autoDecisions.summary: Use a combined patch when provably exact, falling back to per-commit sections (issue's option 2 with option 1 fallback)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue recommends it; it keeps the common case a normal diff and the fallback is always exact.

autoDecisions.summary: Carry section labels as mbox 'From <sha>'/'Subject:' preambles inside the diff text
autoDecisions.rationale: @pierre/diffs parsePatchFiles already splits on them (verified on 1.1.22), so the /diffs/full response shape stays unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Decide contiguity by content equality (git diff --quiet a_i a_{i+1}^ -- path, and a_last vs HEAD when uncommitted) rather than rev-list membership
autoDecisions.rationale: Content equality is exactly the condition under which the combined diff equals the conversation's own changes, independent of merges or author-date order.

autoDecisions.summary: List counts are Changes API per-file sums even when a combined patch's net differs
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the counts to equal the Changes API numbers.

autoDecisions.summary: Include a small frontend item to render section labels
autoDecisions.rationale: Without labels, repeated blocks of the same file in fallback mode are unexplained; the issue asks for sections headed by short sha and subject.

items.title: Add conversation-diff-own.ts that builds a conversation's own per-file patches

expected_outputs: conversation-diff-own.test.ts passes all seven named cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5418.md WI-1 exactly: new module src/lib/overdeck/conversation-diff-own.ts exporting UNCOMMITTED_SECTION_SHA, sectionPreamble, ownFileChanges (per-file sums, kind rule D6), untrackedFilePatch (moved unchanged from conversation-diffs.ts) and buildOwnPatches(repoRoot, changes, paths, options) -> { plain, sections } following the FR-3 combined-patch rule (content checks with git diff --quiet), per-commit git show sections with mbox preambles otherwise, an uncommitted section last (D8), renames always sectioned with -M and both paths (D9), unresolvable shas skipped (D4). execFile with arg arrays only; never import conversation-diffs.ts or conversation-changes.ts. Write the seven named tests in tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversation-diff-own.test.ts against real temp git repos with real shas. Fixture commits use strictly increasing explicit author/committer dates.

items.title: Given an attributed one-line commit to X followed by a foreign commit adding 50 lines to X, buildOwnPatches returns one plain patch containing the one-line change and none of the 50 lines, and an empty sections array

Given a foreign commit between two attributed commits to X, buildOwnPatches returns two sections starting with 'From <sha> ', the older attributed sha in sections[0] and the newer in sections[1], with no foreign lines in either

Given an attributed commit, a later foreign commit and an uncommitted attributed edit to X, buildOwnPatches emits the commit section plus a final section starting 'From 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ' and the foreign lines appear in neither

ownFileChanges returns +4/-1 for commits of +1/-1 and +3/-0, kind 'A' for a file created then edited, kind 'D' for a file deleted last; a commit with an unresolvable sha produces no patch and no exception
Route getConversationDiffFull's cwd-repo block through buildOwnPatches

expected_outputs: both test files pass including the two new PAN-5418 cases
typecheck and lint (incl. lint:circular, file-size guard) complete without errors
